en-US: Add paper editor themes such as Letter, Guide, Blueprint, and Journal. Copy to WeChat uses the same style, and a live phone preview follows editor scroll.
Collapse the notebook sidebar into an icon rail to give the editor more room.
Play common video attachments inline, and delete in-note video and file attachment cards.
Enter Android note editing without remounting the viewer, so the editor no longer loses its place.
List EdgeEver Tasks as an official marketplace plugin, and fix GitHub plugin release tags and plugin panel tab switching.
zh-CN: 新增暖笺、教程、蓝图、刊物等纸稿编辑器主题，复制到公众号时沿用同一风格，并提供跟随滚动的实时手机预览。
笔记本侧栏可收成图标轨道，给编辑区腾出更多空间。
常见视频附件可在笔记内直接播放，也可直接删除笔记中的视频和文件附件卡片。
Android 进入笔记编辑时不再重新挂载阅读视图，避免编辑状态丢失。
插件市场列出官方 EdgeEver Tasks，并修复 GitHub 插件发行标签与面板标签页切换。
